instructions: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
HOLLOWFIELD CYCLE TOURS - GREENWAY RIDE
Booking form

Date of ride: Saturday (1) ........ August
Departure: (2) ........ a.m.
Name: (3) ........
Local address: (4) ........ Mill Lane
Price per rider: £(5) ........
Length of route: (6) ........ kilometres
Lunch: included; the group stops at a (7) ........ halfway round
Rider must bring: a (8) ........
Meeting point: the (9) ........, Priory Street
Booking reference: (10) ........

items.evidence: I could offer you the twenty-ninth.
items.explanation: The customer first asks for the 22nd, but that day is full; the date the staff member suggests and the customer accepts is the 29th.

items.evidence: So that's quarter past nine, not quarter to ten.
items.explanation: On the last weekend of the month the tour starts half an hour earlier than usual; departure is 9.15, not 9.45.
The person making the booking spells out their surname: F-E-R-R-A-N-D-E-Z.

items.evidence: Number fourteen — no, hang on, it's fourteen A.
items.explanation: The customer first says fourteen, then corrects herself: the number of the guesthouse they are staying at is 14A.

items.evidence: The ride is thirty-five pounds a head
items.explanation: The tour price per rider is £35; a hybrid or road bike is included in this price, only an electric bike costs extra.
The brochure still says 38 kilometres; when the route was changed in spring to avoid the main road, the distance increased to 42 kilometres.

items.prompt: Lunch: included; the group stops at a (7) ........ halfway round
items.evidence: We stop at a farm café at the halfway point.
items.explanation: Lunch is included in the price; the group stops at a farm café halfway round.

items.evidence: What we can't lend you is a water bottle, so do bring one of those.
items.explanation: The helmet is provided by the company; the one thing that cannot be lent, so the rider must bring it themselves, is a water bottle.

items.evidence: so the meeting point is now the Waterside Depot on Priory Street
items.explanation: The group used to meet at the station car park; because it got in the way of buses, the meeting point has moved to the Waterside Depot on Priory Street.
The staff member gives the reference for the confirmation letter to be sent that afternoon as letters and numbers: G-W-941.
